authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: State TWO ways meiosis creates genetic variation and explain why meiosis is essential in sexual reproduction.
questionText.af: Noem TWEE maniere waarop meiose genetiese variasie skep en verduidelik waarom meiose noodsaaklik is vir geslagtelike voortplanting.
questionText.xh: Chaza iindlela EZIMBINI i-meiosis eyenza ngayo iyantlukwano yemfuza uze uchaze ukuba kutheni ibalulekile ekuzaleni ngesondo.

scaffoldHint.en: Think of crossing over, independent assortment and haploid gametes.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan oorkruising, onafhanklike rangskikking en haploïede gamete.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga nge-crossing over, ulungelelwaniso oluzimeleyo kunye ne-haploid gametes.

memoText.en: Crossing over and independent assortment create new allele combinations. Meiosis halves the chromosome number to form haploid gametes so fertilisation restores the diploid number.
memoText.af: Oorkruising en onafhanklike rangskikking skep nuwe alleelkombinasies. Meiose halveer die chromosoomgetal om haploïede gamete te vorm sodat bevrugting die diploïede getal herstel.
memoText.xh: I-crossing over kunye nolungelelwaniso oluzimeleyo zenza indibaniselwano ezintsha zee-allele. I-meiosis yehlisa inani lee-chromosome ukuze yenze i-haploid gametes, ukuze ukudibana kweegamete kubuyisele inani le-diploid.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Give THREE reproductive strategies in vertebrates that increase offspring survival.
questionText.af: Gee DRIE voortplantingstrategieë by gewerweldes wat die oorlewing van nageslag verhoog.
questionText.xh: Nika iindlela EZINTATHU zokuzala kwizilwanyana ezinomqolo ezandisa ukusinda kwenzala.

scaffoldHint.en: Think about fertilisation, embryo protection and parental care.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan bevrugting, embrio-beskerming en ouersorg.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga ngokudibana kweegamete, ukhuseleko lwe-embryo kunye nokhathalelo lwabazali.

memoText.en: Examples: internal fertilisation; protected development in the mother or an amniotic egg; parental care; fewer offspring with greater investment.
memoText.af: Voorbeelde: interne bevrugting; beskermde ontwikkeling in die moeder of 'n amniotiese eier; ouersorg; minder nageslag met groter investering.
memoText.xh: Imizekelo: ukudibana kweegamete ngaphakathi; ukukhula okukhuselekileyo kumama okanye eqandeni le-amniotic; ukhathalelo lwabazali; inzala embalwa enotyalo-mali olukhulu.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Explain how FSH, oestrogen and LH act from the start of the menstrual cycle up to ovulation.
questionText.af: Verduidelik hoe FSH, estrogeen en LH vanaf die begin van die menstruele siklus tot by ovulasie werk.
questionText.xh: Chaza indlela i-FSH, i-oestrogen kunye ne-LH ezisebenza ngayo ukusuka ekuqaleni komjikelo ukuya kwi-ovulation.

scaffoldHint.en: Use the sequence FSH → follicle → oestrogen → LH surge → ovulation.
scaffoldHint.af: Gebruik die volgorde FSH → follikel → estrogeen → LH-styging → ovulasie.
scaffoldHint.xh: Sebenzisa ulandelelwano FSH → follicle → oestrogen → ukunyuka kwe-LH → ovulation.

memoText.en: FSH stimulates follicle development. The follicle secretes oestrogen, which rebuilds the endometrium. High oestrogen triggers an LH surge, and the LH surge causes ovulation.
memoText.af: FSH stimuleer follikelontwikkeling. Die follikel skei estrogeen af, wat die endometrium herstel. Hoë estrogeen veroorsaak 'n LH-styging, en die LH-styging veroorsaak ovulasie.
memoText.xh: I-FSH ikhuthaza ukukhula kwe-follicle. I-follicle ikhupha i-oestrogen, eyakha kwakhona i-endometrium. I-oestrogen ephezulu ibangela ukunyuka kwe-LH, kwaye oko kubangela i-ovulation.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: A learner touches a hot object and withdraws the hand. Describe the path of the nerve impulse in this reflex action.
questionText.af: 'n Leerder raak aan 'n warm voorwerp en trek die hand terug. Beskryf die roete van die senuwee-impuls in hierdie refleksaksie.
questionText.xh: Umfundi uchukumisa into eshushu aze asuse isandla. Chaza indlela ye-nerve impulse kule reflex action.

scaffoldHint.en: Start at the receptor and end at the effector.
scaffoldHint.af: Begin by die reseptor en eindig by die effektor.

memoText.en: Receptor in skin → sensory neuron → spinal cord/relay neuron → motor neuron → effector muscle. The muscle contracts and the hand is withdrawn.
memoText.af: Reseptor in vel → sensoriese neuron → rugmurg/skakelneuron → motoriese neuron → effektorspier. Die spier trek saam en die hand word teruggetrek.
memoText.xh: I-receptor esikhumbeni → sensory neuron → spinal cord/relay neuron → motor neuron → effector muscle. Isihlunu siyafinyela size isandla sisuswe.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Explain how insulin lowers a blood glucose level that is above normal.
questionText.af: Verduidelik hoe insulien 'n bloedglukosevlak wat bo normaal is, verlaag.
questionText.xh: Chaza indlela i-insulin ehlisa ngayo iglucose yegazi xa iphezulu kunesiqhelo.

scaffoldHint.en: Identify the pancreas and what insulin makes body cells do.
scaffoldHint.af: Identifiseer die pankreas en wat insulien liggaamselle laat doen.
scaffoldHint.xh: Chonga i-pancreas kunye nento i-insulin eyenza iiseli zomzimba ziyenze.

memoText.en: Beta cells of the pancreas secrete insulin. Insulin increases glucose uptake by cells and promotes conversion of glucose to glycogen in liver and muscle, lowering blood glucose.
memoText.af: Beta-selle van die pankreas skei insulien af. Insulien verhoog glukose-opname deur selle en bevorder die omskakeling van glukose na glikogeen in lewer en spiere, wat bloedglukose verlaag.
memoText.xh: Iiseli ze-beta ze-pancreas zikhupha i-insulin. I-insulin yandisa ukungena kweglucose kwiiseli kwaye ikhuthaza ukuguqulwa kwayo ibe yi-glycogen kwisibindi nakwizihlunu, ngaloo ndlela ithoba iglucose yegazi.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Describe TWO responses that cool the body when body temperature rises above normal.
questionText.af: Beskryf TWEE reaksies wat die liggaam afkoel wanneer liggaamstemperatuur bo normaal styg.
questionText.xh: Chaza iimpendulo EZIMBINI ezipholisa umzimba xa ubushushu bomzimba bunyuka ngaphezu kwesiqhelo.

scaffoldHint.en: Use skin blood vessels and sweat glands.
scaffoldHint.af: Gebruik bloedvate in die vel en sweetkliere.
scaffoldHint.xh: Sebenzisa imithambo yegazi esikhumbeni kunye namadlala okubila.

memoText.en: Vasodilation increases heat loss at the skin. Sweat production increases, and evaporation removes heat from the skin.
memoText.af: Vasodilatasie verhoog hitteverlies by die vel. Sweetproduksie neem toe, en verdamping verwyder hitte van die vel.
memoText.xh: I-vasodilation yandisa ukuphuma kobushushu esikhumbeni. Ukubila kuyanda, kwaye ukuphuphuma kombilo kususa ubushushu esikhumbeni.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Explain why a young shoot bends toward light coming from one side.
questionText.af: Verduidelik waarom 'n jong loot na lig buig wat van een kant af kom.
questionText.xh: Chaza ukuba kutheni ihlumelo eliselula ligoba lisingise ekukhanyeni okuvela kwicala elinye.

scaffoldHint.en: Think about auxin and cell elongation on the shaded side.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan ouksien en selverlenging aan die skadukant.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga nge-auxin kunye nokoluleka kweeseli kwicala elisemthunzini.

memoText.en: Auxin accumulates on the shaded side and stimulates greater cell elongation there. That side grows faster, so the shoot bends toward the light.
memoText.af: Ouksien versamel aan die skadukant en stimuleer groter selverlenging daar. Daardie kant groei vinniger, daarom buig die loot na die lig.
memoText.xh: I-auxin iqokelelana kwicala elisemthunzini kwaye ikhuthaza ukoluleka okukhulu kweeseli apho. Elo cala likhula ngokukhawuleza, ngoko ihlumelo ligoba lisingise ekukhanyeni.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Give THREE human activities that increase greenhouse-gas emissions and ONE likely consequence of global warming for South Africa.
questionText.af: Gee DRIE menslike aktiwiteite wat kweekhuisgasvrystellings verhoog en EEN waarskynlike gevolg van aardverwarming vir Suid-Afrika.
questionText.xh: Nika imisebenzi yabantu EMITHATHU eyandisa iigesi ze-greenhouse kunye NESIPHUMO ESINYE esinokwenzeka sokufudumala komhlaba eMzantsi Afrika.

scaffoldHint.en: Think about fossil fuels, land use and changing rainfall or heat.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan fossielbrandstowwe, grondgebruik en veranderende reënval of hitte.
scaffoldHint.xh: Cinga ngamafutha efosili, ukusetyenziswa komhlaba kunye notshintsho kwimvula okanye ubushushu.

memoText.en: Activities include burning fossil fuels for electricity/industry, transport fuel use and deforestation. Consequences may include more heatwaves, altered rainfall/drought, wildfire risk, sea-level impacts or ecosystem shifts.
memoText.af: Aktiwiteite sluit in die verbranding van fossielbrandstowwe vir elektrisiteit/nywerheid, vervoerbrandstof en ontbossing. Gevolge kan meer hittegolwe, veranderde reënval/droogte, veldbrandrisiko, seevlakimpakte of ekosisteemverskuiwings insluit.
memoText.xh: Imisebenzi ibandakanya ukutshisa amafutha efosili kumbane/nakwimizi-mveliso, amafutha ezithuthi kunye nokugawulwa kwamahlathi. Iziphumo zingabandakanya amaza obushushu, utshintsho kwimvula/imbalela, imililo, ukunyuka kolwandle okanye utshintsho kwi-ecosystem.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Name the THREE components of a DNA nucleotide, then state the role of mRNA in protein synthesis.
questionText.af: Noem die DRIE komponente van 'n DNS-nukleotied en noem dan die rol van mRNA in proteïensintese.
questionText.xh: Chaza amacandelo AMATHATHU e-DNA nucleotide, uze uchaze indima ye-mRNA ekwenziweni kweprotheyini.

scaffoldHint.en: Recall phosphate, deoxyribose, nitrogenous base; then think of codons carried to a ribosome.
scaffoldHint.af: Onthou fosfaat, deoksiribose en stikstofbasis; dink dan aan kodons wat na 'n ribosoom gedra word.
scaffoldHint.xh: Khumbula i-phosphate, i-deoxyribose kunye ne-nitrogenous base; emva koko cinga ngee-codon ezisiwa kwi-ribosome.

memoText.en: A DNA nucleotide contains phosphate, deoxyribose sugar and a nitrogenous base. mRNA carries the copied genetic code as codons from DNA to a ribosome for translation.
memoText.af: 'n DNS-nukleotied bevat fosfaat, deoksiribose-suiker en 'n stikstofbasis. mRNA dra die gekopieerde genetiese kode as kodons van DNS na 'n ribosoom vir translasie.
memoText.xh: I-DNA nucleotide ine-phosphate, iswekile ye-deoxyribose kunye ne-nitrogenous base. I-mRNA ithwala ikhowudi yemfuza ekotshiweyo njengee-codon ukusuka kwi-DNA ukuya kwi-ribosome ukuze kwenzeke i-translation.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Explain how non-disjunction during meiosis can produce a gamete with an abnormal chromosome number.
questionText.af: Verduidelik hoe nie-disjunksie tydens meiose 'n gameet met 'n abnormale chromosoomgetal kan vorm.
questionText.xh: Chaza indlela i-non-disjunction ngexesha le-meiosis enokuvelisa ngayo igamete enenani lee-chromosome elingaqhelekanga.

scaffoldHint.en: Think about chromosomes or chromatids failing to separate.
scaffoldHint.af: Dink aan chromosome of chromatiede wat nie skei nie.

memoText.en: Homologous chromosomes or sister chromatids fail to separate and move to the same daughter cell. Gametes may therefore have an extra chromosome or be missing one.
memoText.af: Homoloë chromosome of susterchromatiede skei nie en beweeg na dieselfde dogtersel. Gamete kan dus 'n ekstra chromosoom hê of een kort.
memoText.xh: Ii-chromosome ezifanayo okanye ii-sister chromatids azohlukani zize ziye kwiseli enye eyintombi. Iigamete zingaba ne-chromosome eyongezelelweyo okanye ziswele enye.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Brown eye colour ($B$) is dominant over blue ($b$). Cross a heterozygous brown-eyed parent with a blue-eyed parent and give the genotype and phenotype ratios.
questionText.af: Bruin oogkleur ($B$) is dominant oor blou ($b$). Kruis 'n heterosigotiese bruinoog-ouer met 'n blouoog-ouer en gee die genotipe- en fenotipeverhoudings.
questionText.xh: Umbala wamehlo amdaka ($B$) wongamele oluhlaza ($b$). Yenza umnqamlezo womzali onamehlo amdaka one-heterozygous nomzali onamehlo aluhlaza, uze unike umlinganiselo wee-genotype nee-phenotype.

memoText.en: $Bb \times bb$ gives 50% $Bb$ and 50% $bb$. Genotype ratio 1:1. Phenotype ratio 1 brown-eyed : 1 blue-eyed.
memoText.af: $Bb \times bb$ gee 50% $Bb$ en 50% $bb$. Genotipeverhouding 1:1. Fenotipeverhouding 1 bruinoog : 1 blouoog.
memoText.xh: $Bb \times bb$ inika 50% $Bb$ kunye no-50% $bb$. Umlinganiselo wee-genotype ngu-1:1. Umlinganiselo wee-phenotype ngu-1 amehlo amdaka : 1 amehlo aluhlaza.

subject: lifesciences
authority: DBE CAPS Grade 12 Life Sciences / Examination Guidelines

questionText.en: Explain how natural selection can increase the frequency of a beneficial trait in a population over many generations.
questionText.af: Verduidelik hoe natuurlike seleksie die frekwensie van 'n voordelige eienskap in 'n bevolking oor baie geslagte kan verhoog.
questionText.xh: Chaza indlela ukhetho lwendalo olunokwandisa ngayo ukuphindaphindeka kophawu oluluncedo kuluntu kwizizukulwana ezininzi.

scaffoldHint.en: Use variation, selection pressure, survival, reproduction and inheritance.
scaffoldHint.af: Gebruik variasie, seleksiedruk, oorlewing, voortplanting en oorerwing.
scaffoldHint.xh: Sebenzisa iyantlukwano, uxinzelelo lokhetho, ukusinda, ukuzala kunye nokudluliselwa kwemfuza.

memoText.en: Heritable variation exists. Individuals with a beneficial trait survive and reproduce more successfully under the selection pressure. They pass the relevant alleles to more offspring, so those alleles become more common over generations.
memoText.af: Oorerflike variasie bestaan. Individue met 'n voordelige eienskap oorleef en plant meer suksesvol voort onder die seleksiedruk. Hulle dra die relevante allele aan meer nageslag oor, sodat dié allele oor geslagte meer algemeen word.
memoText.xh: Kukho iyantlukwano edluliselwa ngemfuza. Izidalwa ezinophawu oluluncedo zisinda kwaye zizale ngempumelelo ngakumbi phantsi koxinzelelo lokhetho. Zidlulisela ii-allele ezifanelekileyo kwinzala eninzi, ngoko ezo allele ziba zininzi kwizizukulwana.
